perplexity.description:
Best In Show is a greatest hits compilation album by World Party, originally released in 2007. It showcases the pop-rock style of Karl Wallinger, the near one-man-band behind World Party, featuring a selection of tracks drawn mainly from the band's most successful albums, including Goodbye Jumbo (1990), Bang! (1993), and Egyptology (1997). The album highlights Wallinger’s melodic craftsmanship and blend of pop sensibilities with rock and alternative influences, with notable songs like "Ship of Fools," "Way Down Now," and "Put the Message in the Box" representing his signature sound.

Though initially released only in the US and Australia to coincide with tours, Best In Show was not available in the UK or Europe until its expanded reissue in 2025 on Seaview Records Ltd. This reissue features remastered audio and enhanced artwork, along with a vinyl debut pressed on colored 2LPs. The compilation serves as a comprehensive retrospective of World Party’s career, balancing tracks from various albums and including rarities such as "Everybody’s Falling in Love" from the 2012 box set Arkeology. Critically, the album consolidates Wallinger’s reputation as a skilled songwriter and producer, with Goodbye Jumbo having been particularly acclaimed during its original release, including a Grammy nomination and recognition as album of the year by Q magazine.
